title: Puran Poli
description: The festive Maharashtrian flatbread stuffed with a sweet chana dal and jaggery filling, served hot with ghee.
steps: Pressure cook the chana dal with enough water until very soft but not mushy, then drain well.
Cook the dal with the jaggery in a heavy pan, stirring constantly, until the mixture is thick and dry; add the cardamom and nutmeg.
Pass the mixture through a food mill or mash well, then cool and divide into 12 balls.
Knead the maida, atta, turmeric, salt, oil and water into a soft, elastic dough and rest for 30 minutes.
Flatten a dough ball, place a filling ball inside, seal and roll gently into a thin round.
Cook on a hot tawa with a little ghee until golden on both sides and serve hot with more ghee.
